mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate above 4.3% signals weakening labor market conditions, predicting negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) despite UNRATE rising above 4.3%, or the rise does not meet the 0.1pp threshold.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in federal funds rates and rise in industrial production index signal economic expansion, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or the combined effect of FEDFUNDS decline and INDPRO rise does not correlate with positive returns (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion, a sustained decline in federal funds rates signals accommodative monetary policy, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next quarter (60 days).
failure_condition: In the late-cycle expansion regime, 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) despite FEDFUNDS declining, or the regime condition is not met.

mechanism_narrative: Rising industrial production index (INDPRO) indicates supply-side expansion, predicting positive S&P 500 returns over the next week (5 days).
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) despite INDPRO rising, or the rise does not meet the expansionary threshold.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the unemployment rate below 3.5% signals labor market tightening, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next month (20 days).
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) despite UNRATE falling below 3.5%, or the fall does not meet the 0.2pp threshold.

mechanism_narrative: In a post-shock recovery regime, a rise in federal funds rates above 5% signals cautious normalization, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next month (20 days).
failure_condition: In the post-shock recovery regime, 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) despite FEDFUNDS rising above 5%, or the regime condition is not met.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent decline in federal funds rates and unemployment rate signals dual easing, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next month (20 days).
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or the combined effect of FEDFUNDS decline and UNRATE decline does not correlate with positive returns (p > 0.05).
